verdict.rationale: Mastra is an agent framework, so restricting which MCP servers and tools an agent may call is a fair axis. The evidence pack has no documented allowlist or per-tool access-control feature. The closest items are guardrails for prompt-injection and response sanitization, plus general tool-call tracing. Both are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict which servers and individual tools an agent may call through allowlists or per-tool access control
